pages.text: $(l)Broken leg$() — you limp, cannot jump, running hurts; walking on it makes it worse. Without both legs, or with both broken, you $(l)crawl$().

$(l)Broken arm$() — everything is slower ($(cfg)2.5$() times with the main hand), weaker hits. Without an arm you cannot hold an item in it.$(br2)Strong pain slows you and sways your aim. Pain shock (pain above $(cfg)85$()) knocks you down for $(cfg)20–30$() s.
